Brief Biography

I am currently an Assistant Professor in the Department of Intelligent Computing at the College of Computer Science and Electronic Engineering, and the Institute for Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing, Hunan University.

Prior to this, I was a Post-doctoral Research Fellow in the Department of Computer Science at Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), where I also obtained my Ph.D. degree in 2026 under the supervision of Dr. Jie Chen, Prof. Yike Guo, and Prof. Jiming Liu.

Prior to joining HKBU, I worked as a Senior Algorithm Engineer at Bigo in Guangzhou from 2019 to 2021. I received my M.Eng. in Software Engineering from Sun Yat-sen University in 2019 and my B.Eng. in Computer Science and Technology from Xiamen University in 2017.
